snippet.title: Coin Blitz!
snippet.description:
The Coin Blitz store page is now available!
The game will be priced at 6.99 and go on a 10% off discount for the first day of release which will be the 18th of this month!
Push coins and get prizes, add to your wishlist now!
Link to steam page - https://store.steampowered.com/app/2075770/Coin_Blitz/
Follow us on twitter! - https://twitter.com/LudificorStudio
